networkgen.help: Writes a state file with a stochastic network model of any size (Baumeier et al., Phys. Rev. B 86, 184202 (2012)) from a parameter file written by networkfit: sites from a dominance-competition point process, correlated Gaussian site energies, distance dependent connection probability and couplings

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for the default state file name

statefile.help: State file to create, if not given job_name.hdf5

energyfile.help: Optional ASCII file with positions and site energies

parameters.help: Parameter file of the model (root element stochasticnetwork, written by networkfit)

sites.help: Number of sites; 0: as in the parameter file

box.help: Box lengths along x, y and z; if not given, the box of the parameter file scaled to keep its density and shape

seed.help: Seed of the random numbers (the same network on every platform); 0: the seed of the parameter file

trapfactor.help: Multiplies the densities of the trap templates of the parameter file (0: no traps; the density of one trap in the fitted system is uncertain, so scan it)

temperature.help: Temperature for the finite-size check of the density of states (only printed)
